title: OA EXPLANATION OF DAILY EVENTS - the daily events explained in prose: the event-by-event explanations of Table 73 with the daily frame
audit_label: R702 OA daily events prose audit
audit_comment: OA round eighty-nine (capture pp. 247-251): the Explanation of Daily Events - the twenty-nine events of Table 73 explained in prose, the dice, the percentages, and the consequences, plus the daily frame and the ruins type bands, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA EXPLANATION OF DAILY EVENTS, printed capture pp. 247-251 - the daily events prose round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE DAILY FRAME: the daily events the most common encounter, the providers of much of the action, up to three events in a single day by location. THE TWENTY-NINE EXPLAINED: the Bandits (the 2d10 camp-edge count, the two brethren to the main camp, the 3d10 mounted scouts who avoid the fight and may pose as travelers); the Bandit Camp (per the Monster Manual); the Becalmed (the ships rowed); the Contest (the noble station, the judged formal party, the two honor points lost); the Crime (the adventure seed); the Duel (the shukenja exempt); the Entreaty (the pay or the bribe); the Fire small (the 70% arson, the home building, the 70% spread); the Haunting (the see-monthly); the Illness (the 20/80 target, the 2d6 course, the worse-untreated, the save versus death, the rest rule); the Insult (the court complaint, the long-term enemy); the Invitation (the refusal the insult); the Kidnapping (the lovers guise); the Land (the uncharted danger); the Monster (the table roll); the Mystery (the 60% investigation); the Nobles (the 2d10 bushi, the 1d6 samurai, the 1-3 of rank, the 80/20 open and disguised, the palanquins); the Pirates (the 1-3 wako ships); the Plot (the adventure basis); the Ruins (the 01-10 temple at 70%, the 11-60 farmhouse at 20%, the 61-90 shrine at 50%, the 91-100 stockade at 30%); the Ship (the 30% ghost ferrying the dead, the 50% merchant, the 20% warship, the 10% gajin crew); the Shrine (the 10% bless for 24 hours, the 80% curse); the Special (the mission start); the Storm (the 5d6 hours, the 1-2 per hour, the no-travel day, the desert sandstorm); the Stranger (the 30% ordinary with the seven 10s, the travels along); the Traveler (the DM devises); the VIP (the 20d6 bushi, the 10d4 samurai, the announced arrival, the impudent cut down). THE OCR REPAIR: the merchant misprint 509-6 read as 50 per the roll band. The prose codifies per the R431 calculus
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 155 closed, 80 open - the Daily Events prose box flips (census 624 -> 625); NEXT - R703: the Chapter 11 terrain encounter tables (capture pp. 251-261), prefix djq (verify free at the landing), audit "R703 OA terrain encounter tables audit", include after rules/oa73explain.h
